title: Physics and engineering
competency: Relate physics to civil, mechanical, electrical and chemical engineering and to technology.

keywords.def: Using scientific laws to design and build structures, machines and systems.
The products and processes made by engineering to solve problems.

en.text: Engineering applies physics. Civil engineering uses forces, pressure and gravity; mechanical engineering uses mechanics, thermodynamics and aerodynamics; electrical engineering uses electromagnetism; chemical engineering uses molecular physics and thermodynamics. Technology, in turn, gives physics new tools, like X-rays and rockets, so new physics is found.
